name: Repurchase Type 10 Code
definition: Specifies the type of repurchase transaction.

PAIR.name: Pairoff
PAIR.definition: Relates to a transaction that is paired off and netted against one or more previous transactions. A paired off transaction is a buyback to offset and effectively liquidate a prior sale of securities or a sellback to offset and effectively liquidate a prior buy of securities.

ROLP.name: Repo Contract Rollover
ROLP.definition: Relates to a repo rollover of a contract extending the closing or maturity date without the underlying collateral impacted.

CALL.name: Repurchase Call
CALL.definition: Relates to the early closing/maturity date for a term repo or a termination date of an open repo with the underlying collateral.

TOPU.name: Top Up
TOPU.definition: Relates to a repo rollover of a position extending the closing or maturity date.

WTHD.name: Withdrawal
WTHD.definition: Relates to a repo rollover of a position extending the closing or maturity date.
